_meta.purpose: search a deployable P3 scheduler better than slack_old without changing official constants
_meta.protocol: p=alpha*d+beta; C=s+p; next=s+max(p,b); changeover fixed 0.5 s; reserve_min 0.2 s
_meta.selection_protocol: per-case max mean weighted_on_time over first 15 official seeds; candidates scored on first15 only; last15 never used for selection
_meta.review_policy: no added observations (existing VoI experiment was negative)
_meta.legacy_warning: best_p3_sens kap=0.25 changed the official 0.5 s changeover and is excluded
_meta.holdout_independence: candidate family is broad but was motivated by earlier exploratory runs; only first15 enters selection, holdout is reported as untouched outcome data
